entries.responsibility: Typed result Dataset, Numerical and Table CRUD; dataset graph and solution-index binding; sampling/evaluation; axisymmetric measure handling; cleanup and result readback.
invariants: Dataset graph edges are type-scoped: Join reads data/data2, derived datasets read data, Solution.data is a solver alias, and unsupported native types refuse graph proof.
Required reference getter failure, missing required edge, missing component/geometry and cycles are validation refusals before create/update mutation.
Legacy solution-index output keeps compatibility axes but binding_complete requires a resolved solution tag, complete axes and pair mapping proof.
Sampling dispatch uses one verified coord setter and run boundary; a failed run does not fall through to stale getData or a second setter.
Table inspect publishes match=null without a target; table writes compare actual data, imaginary values, complex status and headers after each single setter and stop before the next step.
Axisymmetric temporary measure state is restored in finally and read back; restoration failure is a hard AXISYMMETRY_RESTORE_FAILED outcome.

findings.previous_finding: Table readback previously claimed match from readability without comparing requested values.
findings.evidence: _table_readback has target-scoped match_details; _table_write compares real/imaginary/header values, complex status and stops on mismatch. Commit 032c0a5 changes numeric comparison to exact normalized Python numeric equality, including the 0 versus 1e-13 ignored-setter case. Root reported the bounded targeted test set as 12PASS.
findings.acceptance_boundary: Offline source/test evidence only; no COMSOL table setter claim is promoted to live acceptance here.

findings.previous_finding: Dataset reference getter failures were converted to absent edges.
findings.evidence: _dataset_node_type, _dataset_property_inventory, _dataset_reference_value and _validate_dataset_graph preserve unreadable required edges as DATASET_TYPE_UNREADABLE, DATASET_REFERENCE_UNREADABLE or DATASET_REFERENCE_MISSING; unknown dataset types refuse DATASET_GRAPH_UNVERIFIED. The current source scopes data2 to Join and avoids probing data2 on Solution.
findings.acceptance_boundary: Fake-tree contract tests and source inspection do not prove all native COMSOL dataset types.

findings.previous_finding: dataset_inspect still catches all property inventory/value errors and returns a partial map without read_error/status.
findings.evidence: The current source still has a broad except/pass around properties() and _prop_value().
findings.acceptance_boundary: This remains a known semantic limitation; the bounded graph/readback repair did not claim to repair inspection completeness.

findings.previous_finding: Legacy solution-index shape could claim binding_complete from a solution tag without pair proof.
findings.evidence: The current return requires solution_tag, axis_metadata_complete and pair_mapping_complete; incomplete binding returns binding_complete=false with read_errors rather than guessed axes.

findings.previous_finding: A failed native numerical run could be followed by stale getData or an unverified coordinate-setter retry.
findings.evidence: The current function dispatches the verified set('coord', matrix) once, calls run, and only then reads data; failures propagate. The focused contract test asserts no fallback setter and no getData after a failed run.

findings.previous_finding: Axisymmetric temporary measure restoration was swallowed by broad exception handling.
findings.evidence: The temporary off/run/read is wrapped in finally; restoration uses the native readback helper and a run, and a failed restore raises AXISYMMETRY_RESTORE_FAILED.

entries.responsibility: Fail-closed domain outcome classification, dispatch witness provenance, envelope merging, execution/verification separation and public status constants.
invariants: Unknown engine/cleanup/partial signals outrank ordinary success.
A clean validation refusal requires an explicit validation stage and an explicit witness mutation_issued=false; missing/null or contradictory witness provenance remains UNKNOWN.
classify_envelope carries witness and dispatch-stage provenance from the published envelope without redispatching.
Execution status and verification status remain separate axes; __all__ exports only defined current names.

findings.previous_finding: A validation-labelled refusal could lose reconciliation pressure when a mutation witness contradicted it.
findings.evidence: Current classify merges published witness provenance, sets refusal_proof_contradiction and UNKNOWN when stage/witness proof is incomplete, and classify_envelope extracts nested witness/stage data without a new call.

findings.previous_finding: INCOMPLETE remains in succeeded status tokens while verification maps it to NOT_RUN.
findings.evidence: The separate execution/verification axes intentionally preserve this distinction, but callers must check verification_status before accepting a result.
Current __all__ contains defined names; import-star validation belongs to the fresh software-validation record, not this static report.

limits: Classifier source correctness does not prove that every adapter records a complete witness.

entries.responsibility: Authenticated persistent worker, serial ModelUtil executor, request/job state and idempotency, reflection allowlist, bounded discovery, Java compilation/execution, handle generations and JSON codec.
invariants: Authentication precedes dispatch; native calls are serialized and generation changes clear stale handles.
Java source is hashed and compiled into a content-derived artifact before entrypoint invocation.
Non-finite native numbers are refused as NON_FINITE_JSON_VALUE and published as a structured post-dispatch UNKNOWN rather than invalid NDJSON.
Discovery remains budgeted and returns errors/truncation metadata.

findings.previous_finding: Number values could escape through the JSON writer without a finite-number check.
findings.evidence: encode and Json.write reject non-finite values; reply publishes a structured NON_FINITE_JSON_VALUE refusal with post_dispatch/unknown flags. Fresh targeted JVM evidence is at evidence/phase4_3/runs/java_codec_targeted_1b5e80e_20260922T081000Z and records PASS with no ModelUtil.connect.

findings.finding: executeJava still accepts a caller-provided source artifact path and invokes public static run(Model[,Map]) against a selected model; the worker itself does not impose a trusted source-root/class allowlist or model revision fingerprint.
findings.impact: The route requires upstream trusted-code policy; worker source review alone cannot establish an arbitrary-code sandbox or stale-model protection.

findings.finding: Malformed candidate specs, unknown methods, absent collections and getter failures can be skipped or appended as bounded errors while discovery continues.
findings.impact: A complete-looking result is not exhaustive unless callers inspect errors/truncated_reason.

findings.finding: handles, requests and compiledArtifacts are process-lifetime maps; empty status returns all request state and there is no eviction policy.
findings.impact: Long-lived workers can accumulate memory and expose historical request metadata.

findings.finding: conversion supports String to enum, but conversionScore has no corresponding enum branch.
findings.impact: Valid enum arguments can lose overload selection before conversion.

findings.finding: Malformed authentication JSON is parsed before the inner dispatch failure envelope.
findings.impact: Malformed first-line input can close without a structured authentication failure.

findings.finding: hashRequest sorts top-level keys only; nested map insertion order remains part of the request hash.
findings.impact: Semantically equal nested request bodies with different key order can conflict under one request id.

findings.finding: Tag scan and ModelUtil.create are separate, so collision protection is not atomic.
Caller paths have no trusted-root/no-clobber policy, and failures after create do not remove the model.
Printed scalar has no finite/threshold or fresh-reopen assertion.
Arguments are indexed/port-parsed without structured count/range validation; hasProduct true is not license checkout, solve or acceptance.
